name: Write Childrens Book
description: End-to-end guided journey from initial concept through story development, illustration direction, publishing, and marketing for children's books. Covers board books through middle grade, age-appropriate writing conventions, illustration briefs, self-publishing mechanics, and reaching parents, teachers, and young readers through targeted marketing strategies. Use when the user wants to write childrens book or needs a structured multi-step process for this goal. Do NOT use when the request is a single-step task or requires professional advice beyond educational guidance.
